purpose: Separate estimation of race outcome probabilities from estimation of market price formation so disagreement can be studied without treating either side as truth by default.

OUTCOME_MODEL.target: probability distribution over race outcome object under the existing probability object contract

MARKET_MODEL.target: distribution or trajectory of timestamped market-implied probabilities/odds conditional on information available up to each declared market timestamp
MARKET_MODEL.inputs: timestamp-proven market snapshots plus permitted PRE structure

anti_hindsight_rule: No hypothesis may be promoted as real edge if defined after inspecting the same outcome/market residuals used to support it. Exploratory findings remain exploratory and require a separately prespecified replication set.
market_baseline_rule: The market is the first competitor, not an oracle. Market-only probability quality must be measured under the same temporal split and cutoff contract as outcome models.
economics_boundary: Expected value, turnover, liquidity, self-impact, variance, drawdown, and risk-of-ruin research are downstream and require separate authorization after probability-quality evidence.
next_gate: Inventory timestamp-proven historical market snapshots and their publisher semantics without opening protected or settlement-only sources.
